proposal.observation: Frozen Phase-1 model ZN-E010 (AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU): split 2021 MAPE 0.3325, Acc@15 0.3665, RMSE 425.0; 3-split MAPE 0.332±0.016, Acc@15 0.324±0.067. On every Phase-1 run the >1000-cycle cells are underpredicted by ~830-1070 cycles (ZN-E010: -970) and 500-1000 cells by ~300-600; diagnostics/phase1_breakthrough_diagnosis.md attributes this to Relative Huber dL/dyhat = ±delta/y (6-13x weaker pull on long-life cells) and its gradient clipping above |rel err| 0.15.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Adding the registered statistical tail term stat_tail_balance (loss.md §4.7: tau-weighted Huber on relative errors beyond ±0.15, under-prediction weighted by w = clip(y/mu,1,3)) with lambda2 = 0.25 x median gradient ratio raises long-life predictions without hurting short-life cells: >1000 and 500-1000 band bias shrinks, and split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3245 or RMSE <= 404.0 or Acc@15 >= 0.3865 vs ZN-E010 under §7.
proposal.question_inherited: Is the shared long-life underprediction removed by rebalancing the loss tail rather than the architecture?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether the Relative-Huber 1/y underweighting is the cause of the long-life bias on ZN-coin.
proposal.why_this_experiment: Phase 2 opened by A5-ZN; the diagnosis names the loss mechanism; stat_tail_balance is the registered term that targets exactly the 1/y underweighting and clipping (loss.md §4.7, rank 1 in the Li-ion Argon report). Statistical, not physics; label-dependent.
proposal.modification: Loss only: L = RelativeHuber_0.15 + lambda2 * L_tail, L_tail = mean[tau*Huber_0.5(e+) + (1-tau)*w*Huber_0.25(e-)], r=(yhat-y)/max(y,1), e+=ReLU(r-0.15), e-=ReLU(-r-0.15), w=clip(y/mu,1,3), tau=0.55, mu = train label mean; lambda2 = rho2 * median_b(||grad L_main|| / ||grad L_tail||) on 3 fixed train batches before step 1, rho2 = 0.25 (registered). Model, data and optimiser identical to ZN-E010.
proposal.changed_components: Objective: added stat_tail_balance auxiliary term (lambda2 calibrated from gradients).
proposal.held_constant_components: Frozen ZN-E010 architecture (98,113 params, GELU, anchored fade encoder), Relative Huber delta 0.15 main loss, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, checkpoint rule, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps; lambda2 never tuned on validation.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE vs ZN-E010; EOL-band MAPE and bias (500-1000, >1000) and <500 regression; lambda2, gradient ratio R and cosine trajectory, active/under/over fractions (diagnostics physics2_calibration / physics2_steps / loss_balance); gradient gate.
proposal.rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs frozen reference ZN-E010 MAPE 0.3325 / RMSE 425.0 / Acc@15 0.3665 / DB-MAPE 0.3325). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3245 AND RMSE <= 435.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 404.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3355] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.3865 AND MAPE <= 0.3355 AND RMSE <= 435.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3365 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3425 AND gradient gate PASS AND loss balance in band (loss.md §5.3; BALANCE_FAIL -> DISCARD) AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Secondary: >1000 / 500-1000 band bias vs ZN-E010 and <500 MAPE regression <= 0.01.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput. Loss balance: lambda2, R_j median, cosine, active fraction (loss.md §5.3).

architecture_addendum.evidence: Phase-2 loss experiment on the frozen ZN-E010 architecture
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] (h_t) -> u_t=[h_t, h_t-h_1] [B,100,128] -> Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, +h_t -> g_t [B,100,64] * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: h_1 = cycle index 0 (always observed); g_t multiplied by mask; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - first. tests/test_anchored_fade.py: padding invariance and cycle-1 dependence.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE (= MAPE) vs ZN-E005; EOL bands; gradient gate incl. fade_encoder

loss_addendum.lambda: lambda2 = 0.25 x median gradient-norm ratio over 3 fixed train batches (all trainable params, float64), logged; never tuned on validation
loss_addendum.balance_checks: loss.md §5.3: median R in [0.05, 2.0] after warm-up, no two consecutive R > 5, active fraction > 0; cosine logged
loss_addendum.units: dimensionless relative error (same scale as the main loss)
